title: Washos Engine mod.json
description: Manifest for a Washos Engine mod. See docs/MODS_FORMAT.md for full details.

name.description: Display name shown in the mod selector and mod manager.

version.description: Free-form version string. Convention is semantic versioning.

description.description: Short description shown in the mod manager. Use \n for a line break.

homepage.description: Optional URL. Stored on the mod's metadata, shown in the details popup.

icon.description: Path to a PNG for the selector preview. Relative to the mod folder, or res:// form. Falls back to Icon.png / icon.png at the mod root.

background_color.description: Hex color for the selector background when this mod is selected. Accepts #RRGGBB, RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, RRGGBBAA.

main_scene.description: Entry point, res:// form. Either a .tscn scene or a .gd script that extends Node.

autoloads.description: Named globals available to every script in the mod.

settings.description: ProjectSettings overrides applied while this mod is running. Only whitelisted keys are honored.
